description: This file contains style definitions for dashboard components in the Superset frontend, including header styles, focus styles, and tooltip styles.

methods.name: headerStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for header elements (h1-h6) with theme-based font sizes and weights.

methods.name: chartHeaderStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for chart header controls, including margins and paddings.

methods.name: filterCardPopoverStyle
methods.description: Defines styles for filter card tooltips and their arrow positioning.

methods.name: chartContextMenuStyles
methods.description: Defines styles for chart context menus and submenus with theme-based widths.

methods.name: focusStyle
methods.description: Defines focus styles for various interactive elements, including box-shadow and outline removal.
